title: C13 check the pull request is still open before a follow-up push

rule.start: - Before pushing follow-up commits to a PR branch
rule.end: - When multiple related changes span different concerns

prompts: We're on the branch for PR #12. Change the greeting in src/greet.py from 'Hello' to 'Hello there', then commit and push it to the PR.
Thanks. One more follow-up for that PR: the example output in README.md still says 'Hello', so update it to match. Commit and push.
